The '''7th Sky Corps''' was a [[Corps/Legends|corps]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] under the joint command of [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone marshal commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Notable units in the 7th Sky Corps included the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]] which specialized in offensive scenarios, [[Ghost Company/Legends|Ghost Company]], specializing in reconnaissance, the [[2nd Airborne Company/Legends|2nd Airborne Company]], and [[Parjai Squad]].

==History==
[[File:212th_Battalion.png|thumb|left|300px|[[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]] on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]].]]
Though [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] was the overall [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the 7th Sky Corps, he later took personal command of the [[212th Attack Battalion]], which was also led by [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who developed a friendship with the [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] commander during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The 212th was a well-known and effective battalion which would often be sent to participate in major battles during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The 212th were often deployed alongside the [[501st Legion|501st]] in missions and battles across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

During the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], Commander Cody and the 212th aided [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|Generals]] Obi-Wan Kenobi and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="TCW Film" /> After being breached unexpectedly by [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces, it was soon revealed that one of their brothers was a [[Treason/Legends|traitor]]. Cody helped [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] hunt down the traitor who was none other then [[Slick/Legends|Slick]]. During the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] counter attack, the 212th Battalion, along with [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]], helped beat back droid forces.<ref name="THE">{{TCW|The Hidden Enemy}}</ref>

In the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]], the battalion, led by Cody, went with Kenobi to aid Anakin Skywalker and the remainder of Torrent Company which had been overrun by droid forces, and later defeated the droid forces under command of [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].<ref name="TCW Film">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>

In the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], Ghost Company helped Kenobi eliminate several [[Proton cannon/Legends|proton cannons]] to allow ground invasion forces to land. After encountering starved [[Gutkurr/Legends|gutkurrs]], the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] created a diversion while Kenobi and [[Clone trooper/Legends|troopers]] [[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]] and [[Boil/Legends|Boil]] helped the general destroy the [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]], allowing the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator'' assault ships]] to land and initiate the invasion. Republic troops would later march to the capital city of [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]], liberating the [[Ryloth/Legends|planet]] from Separatist [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]].<ref name="IoR">{{TCW|Innocents of Ryloth}}</ref>

During the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]], General Kenobi, Cody, and the 212th were assigned to lead the central charge upon landing. They were the first to land on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], while the 501st and General [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]]'s battalion were forced to land before reaching their landing zones, rendering them unable to provide support. When Kenobi's [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] crashed behind enemy lines, Cody sent Waxer and Boil to retrieve Kenobi and return with the wounded [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. The 212th, though vastly outnumbered and forced onto the defensive, lined up their gunships and [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TEs]] in a circle formation and used them as gun emplacement platforms to hold the encircling droid forces at bay. The 212th were able to hold out against the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] and their droid forces, albeit with significant [[Death/Legends|casualties]], until Generals Skywalker's 501st and Ki-Adi-Mundi's forces finally arrived with air support. Due to sustaining numerous casualties, the 212th would not participate in the following attack on the Geonosian [[Stalgasin hive/Legends|capital]].<ref name="LAPR">{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}}</ref>

[[File:GAR_War_Council_EGTW.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The 7th Sky Corps was known to work in tandem with the 501st Legion.]]
In the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]], General Kenobi and the 212th spearheaded the Republic ground attack, going straight for the [[Umbaran capital city/Legends|Umbaran capital]] while the 501st provided support by eliminating enemy supplies. Obi-Wan called on General [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]], who was the interim commander of the 501st in Skywalker's absence, to help aid the siege through various means, such as destroying an [[Umbaran airbase/Legends|Umbaran airbase]].<ref name="DoU">{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}}</ref>

While the majority of 212th forces sieged the Umbaran capital itself, Krell ordered a [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] led by Waxer to search the [[Forest/Legends|forests]] for enemy guerrillas disguised in 501st [[Armor/Legends|armor]], unaware that the 501st were given the same order. The 212th and 501st cut each other down with [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire and [[Mortar/Legends|mortars]] until the captain in charge of the 501st realized they were shooting at fellow clones. Waxer had been fatally wounded but was able to tell Rex that Krell gave the order. The survivors of the platoon joined the 501st in attacking and capturing, at great cost, the traitor, General Krell. Later, the main forces of the 212th successfully took down the capital and dispatched squadrons to destroy the remainder of Separatist forces on Umbara, including the droid battalion which was en route to attack the Umbaran airbase captured by the 501st, effectively ending the Battle of Umbara.<ref name="CoK">{{TCW|Carnage of Krell}}</ref>

During the [[Attack on Obi-Wan Kenobi's fleet/Legends|Attack on Obi-Wan Kenobi's fleet]], the 212th aided in the unsuccessful attempt of repelling Separatist forces from the [[Negotiator/Legends|''Negotiator'']], failing due to the superior number of droids and the presence of [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Most of the battalion escaped via [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] after General Obi-wan Kenobi ordered a retreat.<ref name="BfR">{{TCW|Bound for Rescue}}</ref>

The 212th was sent to [[Sarrish/Legends|Sarrish]] in an attempt to neutralize Separatist forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Although the 212th initially managed to push back the enemy, the Separatist's superiority in numbers and their geographical advantage gradually forced back the 212th forces, instigating heavy casualties in the process.<ref name="Routine Valor">{{StoryCite|story=Routine Valor|book=Free Comic Book Day 2006 Special}}</ref> [[Clone commando/Legends|Clone commando]] [[Gregor/Legends|Gregor]] was determined Missing in Action after trying to rescue his squadmates who were pinned down by enemy fire during the battle.<ref name="MIA">{{TCW|Missing in Action}}</ref>

On [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], General Kenobi, Commander Cody, and the elite [[Squad Seven (Galactic Republic)|Squad Seven]] breached [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]'s [[Nute Gunray's citadel|fortress]] and secured vital data that began the [[hunt for Darth Sidious]].<ref name="LoE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>

When General Kenobi was tasked with [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|tracking down]] and eliminating the [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Separatist Supreme Commander]], General Grievous, he took the 212th. Cody's troopers stormed Grievous's stronghold on the tenth level of [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]], and kept his droid forces at bay while Kenobi faced the General himself in single combat. The clones would take heavy casualties in the battle due to the superior numbers of droids, but would eventually gain the advantage, and later destroyed all the droid forces stationed on the planet.<ref name="ROTS" />

Although Obi-Wan defeated Grievous, matters took a turn when [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Sidious]] transmitted [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] to Cody. Cody was ordered to command an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] walker to open fire on the general, sending him to his apparent death hundreds of feet below. The clones went on to destroy the remaining [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] forces on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], and, as per the new [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] orders, subjugated the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="ROTS" />

==Units within the 7th Sky Corps==
*[[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]]: Distinguished by orange markings, the 212th Attack Battalion notably helped General Kenobi during the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]].
**[[Ghost Company/Legends|Ghost Company]]: Ghost Company notably helped General Kenobi during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]].
**[[2nd Airborne Company/Legends|2nd Airborne Company]]: The 2nd Airborne Company made huge drops from high altitudes, with specialized armor and a specialized helmet to do so.
***[[Parjai Squad]] - Parjai Squad was part of the 2nd Airborne Company.

==Vehicles==
The 7th Sky Corps was known to field [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttles]], [[TX-130 Fighter Tank|TX-130]], [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT gunships]], [[All Terrain Attack Pod/Legends|AT-AP]], [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|AT-RT]], and [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]].
